title: Grandma’s House
description: After his football game, kid-2 hopes to shower and nap in peace. He suggests that kid-3 visit Grandma, and she is thrilled by the idea.
alt: In a cozy living room, kid-2 stands in his football uniform with a gear bag and helmet while kid-3 hugs a stuffed bunny and wears a backpack. Kid-2 says, 'After my game, I’m taking a shower and a nap. Can you go to Grandma’s so it’s quiet?' Kid-3 excitedly replies, 'I get to go to Grandma’s? Yay!'
